verdict.rationale: The docs say AI Gateway automatically retries failed requests on other providers. Engineers can shape that failover with `order`, `only` and `sort`, and with per-provider timeouts that trigger fast failover. BYOK failures are also retried with system credentials. However, the evidence shows no policy controls specific to retries, and the documented retries are cross-provider failover rather than configurable retries of transient errors. Missing for 10: configurable retry counts/backoff, error-class (transient vs. permanent) retry rules, same-provider retry options, independent or hands-on corroboration.
